retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style graphic layout featuring ultra-condensed block typography, a mauve background, and a repetitive row of circular halftone vignettes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat, graphic composition dominated by three tiers of heavy, condensed sans-serif text. The top tier is orange, while the lower two are white. A row of circular photographic vignettes runs along the bottom edge, and a black 'stereo' banner with arrows sits at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of high-contrast condensed typography
Repetitive circular motifs anchoring the bottom horizontal axis
Triadic color harmony between mauve, orange, and white
Geometric balance between the large text blocks and the small circular icons
coreInvariants: Ultra-condensed sans-serif letterforms with flat terminals
Mauve or dusty pink solid background
Horizontal row of circular halftone images at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography occupies the central 70% of the frame, scaled to nearly touch the left and right margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white block text in the center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top 'Stereo' banner, moves down through the orange text to the white text, and finally rests on the row of circles at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily appearing as the mauve background surrounding the tight typographic blocks.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange for secondary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted background saturation contrasted with high-value white and high-saturation orange.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and U characters are elongated rectangles with rounded corners
M and N have vertical outer strokes with sharp interior angles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family using color (orange vs white) to denote hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary text.
Provides the clean, tall sans-serif structure required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid mauve background with a row of 7-8 small circular halftone images along the bottom edge and a thin black horizontal line with arrows at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text. The top line in orange, the bottom two lines in white, stacked tightly with minimal leading.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the background a consistent mauve/pink tone?
Are there circular vignettes at the bottom?
Is the 'Stereo' banner present at the top?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the bottom circles
Check that the orange text is legible against the mauve
Confirm the halftone texture in the circles is visible
recipe.reuseFormula: Mauve Background + Ultra-Condensed Block Type + Bottom Row Circles = 60s Surf Aesthetic
